summary.text: Jacob Burnett, 30, of Middleton, is an independent write-in candidate for governor of Idaho. His stated priorities are agency audits and lobbying transparency, lowering personal property taxes and slowing speculative out-of-state development, and expanded telehealth and parental choice in education.

paragraphs.text: Burnett lists his hometown as Middleton and his occupation as self-employed.
He says he has lived in Idaho for 30 years.
